summary.text: Jay Chaudhuri is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who represents District 15 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he was first appointed to the chamber on April 19, 2016, to represent District 16, and ran in District 15 in 2018 because of redistricting.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Chaudhuri's tenure in the Senate as beginning in 2016 and says he assumed office in District 15 on January 1, 2019.

For the 2025-2026 session, it lists him as a member of the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment, Appropriations on Education/Higher Education, Commerce and Insurance, Education/Higher Education, Transportation, and Rules and Operations of the Senate committees.
